title: 新闻中的被动与引述
goal: 区分被动句中的行动者和受事者，并识别信息来源。

points.label: 区分被动句中的行动者和承受者
识别引述句的信息来源

sources.title: 全国大学英语四、六级考试大纲（2016年修订版）

body.p: 被动句把动作的承受者放在主语位置。by 后面是行动者。没有 by 短语，行动者往往没有说出来。

body.box: Workers repaired the bridge. / The bridge was repaired by workers.

body.p: 引述句用 said 等词说明消息来自谁。说话的人是消息来源，做事的人在 said 后面的句子里。

cards.title: 主动与被动
rows: The hall is cleaned daily by staff.
The meals are delivered by volunteers.
The bridge is inspected by engineers.
The park is managed by the council.
The road was repaired by workers.
The doors were made by a workshop.
The signs were installed by staff.
The hall was opened by the council.

cards.title: 引述与来源
rows: Officials said workers repaired the road.
officials 是消息来源；workers 执行维修。
It was reported that workers repaired the road.
没有说消息来源；workers 执行维修。
Officials said the road was repaired by workers.
road 是受事者；workers 是行动者。
The repair was reported by officials.
officials 是报道者；没有说谁维修。

body.box:
The town reported that the bridge was inspected by engineers on Monday. The inspection followed a report of damage to the surface. The bridge had remained open while engineers examined the structure. They completed their inspection in the afternoon and gave their findings to the town. Staff will post an update beside the crossing.
Who inspected the bridge?
1. Town reporters
2. The engineers
3. Bridge passengers
4. The town's visitors

body.p: was inspected by engineers 说明检查由工程师完成，第二项正确。town 只是报道这件事的来源。

lines.text: The road was repaired by workers after the storm.

items.why: 依据是 was repaired by workers。by 后面的 workers 是维修者，第二项符合。

lines.text: The meals are delivered by volunteers to the center each morning.

items.why: 依据是 The meals are delivered by volunteers to the center。餐食是被送的东西，第三项符合。

lines.text: The manager said the technicians had checked the heating system.

options: A source that is not named
items.why: 依据是 The manager said。经理是消息来源，第四项符合；technicians 是做检查的人。

lines.text: The change was reported by the council. The new timetable begins on Monday.

options: The council named in the news
A source the news does not name
items.why: 依据是 The change was reported by the council。by 后面的 council 是报道者，第一项符合。

lines.text: The town hall reopened on Monday after work on its entrance. The entrance was repaired by a local building team, and new signs were designed by students at the nearby college. The council paid for the repairs and announced the reopening on Friday. The hall manager said the entrance had been checked before visitors returned. The building team completed the work last Wednesday, and council staff inspected the doors on Thursday. The hall was built forty years ago and is used for meetings, classes and local performances. A college teacher said the sign project gave students an opportunity to work with a public building. The hall's usual programme will continue this month, including an evening talk on the history of the town. Visitors can find a schedule at the entrance or ask staff at the reception desk. The council has not announced any further work on the hall this year.

items.why: 依据是 new signs were designed by students at the nearby college。第二项符合；施工队修的是入口。

items.stem: Who said the entrance had been checked before visitors returned?
items.why: 依据是 The hall manager said the entrance had been checked。第三项符合。

lines.text: The bridge was inspected by engineers on Tuesday after the storm.

options: Someone the news does not name
items.why: 依据是 was inspected by engineers on Tuesday。第三项符合。

lines.text: The council reported that workers repaired the path on Monday.

options: Someone the council did not name
items.why: 依据是 workers repaired the path。第一项符合；council 只是消息来源。

lines.text: New signs are made by the workshop for the town museum.

items.why: 依据是 New signs are made by the workshop for the town museum。工坊做的是给博物馆的标牌，第四项符合。

lines.text: The museum garden was opened by volunteers on Saturday.

items.why: 依据是 The museum garden was opened by volunteers。被打开的是博物馆的花园，第二项符合。

lines.text: Officials said the bridge had been inspected by engineers.

options: A source that is not named
items.why: 依据是 Officials said。官员是消息来源，第三项符合；engineers 是做检查的人。

lines.text: The opening was reported by the library director after staff prepared the room.

options: A source that is not named
items.why: 依据是 The opening was reported by the library director。第一项符合；staff 是布置房间的人。

lines.text: The manager said the signs were installed by a local team.

options: A source that is not named
items.why: 依据是 The manager said。消息来自经理，第四项符合；local team 是安装的人。

lines.text: It was reported that volunteers painted the hall, but the report did not name its source.

items.stem: What is known about the source of the report?
options: Its source asked not to be named.
items.why: 依据是 the report did not name its source。报道没有说明来源，第二项符合。
